description: Task-focused discovery pointers; canonical guidance lives in catalog/index.json and linked Markdown.

tasks.title: Narrow a long list
tasks.summary: Refine many results with visible applied filters, reversible selections and a clear reset.

tasks.title: Compare records quickly
tasks.summary: Choose comparable columns, sorting, search and accessible row actions.

tasks.title: Find a way forward from an empty screen
tasks.summary: Separate first use, filtered-zero and service failure with an appropriate action.
intent_phrases: find a way forward from an empty screen
what to do on an empty state

tasks.title: Complete a form in the right order
tasks.summary: Present clear labels, meaningful groups, a logical reading sequence and predictable validation.
intent_phrases: complete a form in the right order

tasks.title: Recover from a failed submission
tasks.summary: Preserve answers, connect errors to fields and provide a safe retry.

tasks.title: Submit something consequential
tasks.summary: Review answers, change specific responses and confirm the authoritative outcome.

tasks.title: Confirm an irreversible action
tasks.summary: Explain consequences, offer a clear cancel action and return focus appropriately.

tasks.title: Select or create multiple category tags
tasks.summary: Choose existing labels, explicitly create a missing label and retain stable membership identity.
intent_phrases: select or create multiple category tags
add removable chips to a field

tasks.title: Manage an item from a card
tasks.summary: Compose a direct detail link, useful related preview and independent contextual commands.
intent_phrases: manage an item from a card
open related items from a card

tasks.title: Archive versus delete a record
tasks.summary: Select truthful lifecycle semantics and reversible operations across related records.
intent_phrases: move record to trash then restore
when can an undo be promised

tasks.title: Save a dependent item without losing form state
tasks.summary: Verify prerequisite and child writes while retaining draft, focus and truthful outcome across refresh.
intent_phrases: save a dependent item without losing form state

tasks.title: Manage related records from a collection card
tasks.summary: Move from a filtered collection to a related-item editor and safely return.
intent_phrases: manage related records from a collection card
collection to record to child editor
return to filtered collection after edit
choose narrow route or wide detail panel

tasks.title: Drill down from a KPI card
tasks.summary: Keep workspace/project metric scope and filters truthful from summary through details and return.
intent_phrases: understand activity across workspace and projects
preserve date filter after KPI drill down

tasks.title: Edit a related record without nested dialogs
tasks.summary: Choose inline, detail subview, single dialog, drawer or route while preserving back navigation, draft and focus.
intent_phrases: edit a related record without opening nested dialogs
choose between dialog drawer and route for editing
keep edit history in one detail surface
preserve draft when moving between detail and edit
restore focus after closing a nested record task
choose a task surface for mobile and desktop
